introHtml: Custom 100-149 page journals and notebooks strike the ideal balance between portability and substance. They offer enough pages for detailed meeting notes or daily journaling without the bulk of a 200-page book. Perfect for corporate training sessions, client gifts, or employee orientation kits, these mid-size notebooks can be debossed, screen printed, or foil stamped with your logo. Choose from spiral-bound, sewn, or glued options in various trim sizes to match your brand's aesthetic.
